_comment: Standard VAT rates for electronically supplied services (SaaS) to consumers, per buyer country. Used only when EU/UK consumer sales are opened (TAX_B2C_OPEN_REGIONS) after OSS/UK registration; web prices are VAT-inclusive, and the receipt shows the included VAT at this rate. Review every rate before opening a region and whenever a country changes its rate. See docs/billing-tax.md.
sources: European Commission, VAT rates applied in the Member States (Taxes in Europe Database, TEDB)
